bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: Head coach Ben Johnson confirmed that Tyson Bagent will start Sunday's game against the Packers , as Caleb Williams remains week-to-week with his hamstring injury and will not practice this week . The news comes after Chicago's dominant 23-12 win over the Jets, with the Bears also managing a minor setback as running back Kyle Monangai's thumb injury is reportedly not considered serious .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions suffered a disappointing 32-26 defeat to the Carolina Panthers on Sunday Night Football, with their defense coming under heavy criticism for allowing Bryce Young and Carolina to carve them up. The Detroit Lions defensive woes were too much, as they lost to the Carolina Panthers 32-26 on Sunday night.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers are dealing with a major defensive setback after linebacker Edgerrin Cooper suffered a torn Achilles in the win over Tampa Bay, with coverage noting he's a "tough one to lose" for the season, forcing Green Bay to rely on other linebackers . Despite the injury, the Packers managed to hold off the Buccaneers for a 17-14 victory , though the team continues to navigate a string of other injuries including DT Warren Brinson and WR Jayden Reed.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings improved to 4-0 with a 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins, but face significant offensive line concerns heading into their Week 5 matchup against the Saints after left guard Donovan Jackson is likely done for the regular season with a meniscus tear that will require surgery . Additionally, left tackle Christian Darrisaw is in concussion protocol after both players exited Sunday's victory over Miami, leaving the Vikings with questions on the left side of their line .
